d.ko: Build a fortress and try to help your dwarves survive against a deeply generated world. Keep your dwarves happy, grow their community and beware of digging too deeply. The deepest, most intricate simulation of a world that's ever been created.

d.zh: 史上最具深度与复杂性的世界模拟器。传奇游戏《矮人要塞》现已登陆Steam！在这个由程序生成，拥有自洽生态、动态历史与百万细节的幻想宇宙中，构筑一座要塞，努力帮助矮人文明生存下去。
